comment: Zork III scores 'potential', 7 points total, every delta is +1 — the room is the only discriminator. Two events fire in variable rooms and are combat-adjacent; they never wait.

events.note: Hooded figure arrives (SHADOW-1..8 all display 'Land of Shadow'); combat starts immediately — never wait.
Striking the figure with the sword; mid-combat, indistinguishable from shadow-appears by delta+room — both wait 0, so the collision is harmless.
Reaching the ledge starts the sailor/chest exchange.
Dial set to 776 GUE and button pushed. The museum exists in three eras with distinct room ids but the same display name, so roomName matching covers all of them.
Sliding the final wall in the Royal Puzzle — the hardest puzzle in the trilogy. All 8x8 puzzle cells share one room id/name.
